# ex: type wildcard substitution requiring package qualification (ex.go:646-660)
# When a type wildcard in the replacement resolves to a type from another
# package, the qualifier function returns pkg.Name() to produce e.g. "sub.S".
ex ./sub {
	type T any
	[]T -> map[string]T
}
-- x.go --
package m

type A int

var _ []A
-- sub/sub.go --
package sub

import "m"

type B int

var _ []m.A
var _ []B
-- stdout --
diff old/sub/sub.go new/sub/sub.go
--- old/sub/sub.go
+++ new/sub/sub.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@

 type B int

-var _ []m.A
-var _ []B
+var _ map[string]m.A
+var _ map[string]B
